info.title: dotnew
info.description: A .NET CLI tool for quickly scaffolding .cs files with customizable type, accessibility, inheritance, and namespace.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Dotnew is a simple .NET CLI tool to quickly create .cs files with dynamic templating.

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of the entity to create. [default: Class]

options.name: --accessibility
options.description: The accessibility of the entity to create. [default: public]

options.name: --inherits
options.description: The classes and/or interfaces to inherit from. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of the entity to create. When omitted, it is inferred from the nearest .csproj's RootNamespace plus the relative folder path. Pass 'none' to force no namespace.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Whether to use file-scoped or block-scoped namespaces. Ignored if namespace is not set.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the target file if it already exists. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the entity to create, including its relative path. [default: Class1]
